claim_boundary: Plans, schemas, fixtures and static joins only. This is not native implementation, visual/motion approval, live provider/security/storage proof, full packet-audit completion, readiness admission or a governance seal.
repairs: Onboarding v2 carries a durable, closed reversible Project draft with exact choice bytes and reviewed digest, eleven-stage main dependency graph, six-stage connection shortcut and explicit no-Project deferred path.

Settings owns the optional Start fresh/copy preview, exact eligible setting IDs, exclusions and explicit-choice precedence. Its existing preview command supports an uncreated draft; apply still requires a real reserved Project and revalidated ordinary owner preview.

Precommit owner work is narrowly bound to read-only preflight or necessary selected-source authentication. Auth supports a first-time source account without a fabricated Project/profile/installation, and Forge listing supports a real account without a fabricated repository.

One confirmed Project commit uses the existing source-specific owner command/child receipt chain. Acknowledgement, an unlisted Project or an unresolved Settings child result cannot authorize postcommit provider phases.
Paid-provider setup precedes the explicit optional Free Models phase; both require the actual committed Project. Close/resume and Back cannot uncreate or recommit it.

The same thirteen typed local actions remain. Final GUI references the owner stage definitions; eleven existing production command rows gain reverse-consumer/phase requirements without adding rows or activating unavailable handlers.

The existing Onboarding physical family receives a deterministic closed offline bundle of the owner Session and its reachable Project/Settings definitions. Standard contract validation rejects stale inline bundles. No physical family or retention policy was added.
Current prose and consumer mirrors were reconciled directly. Guided Tour retains its separately specified v3 Chat/Teacher, workspace and Planning sequence.
